module_doc: Metrics for an AI alignment evaluation: how often a safety monitor flags model transcripts.
readme_intro: Helpers for an AI safety research project. They compute monitor flag rates over model transcripts for an alignment evaluation, so that researchers can track how often a safety monitor flags model behaviour across evaluation runs.
